title: Maximal-order Buchmann-Lenstra fusion
objective: Fuse T8 Buchmann-Lenstra composite primitives and accelerate the precision12 multiplier cycle with independently checkable compact evidence

handoff.summary: Fused composite Dedekind data and HNF, added one packed order-table/closure boundary, and replaced accepted component-coprime cycle replay with an independently checked theorem certificate. Warm T8 construction is about 4.6-5.0 ms and its checker about 21.8 ms; precision12 compiled construction/checker is about 0.835/0.329 s.
risks: The number-field-algorithms package is 751401 bytes and needs an integration-owned increase from the 725000-byte ratchet.
The broad native suite was stopped at coordinator request after cache preparation/build began; focused native compilation and exact differentials pass.
next_steps: Register packed_row_hnf_in_place, packed_composite_dedekind_basis_in_place, and packed_order_table_in_place together in the production kernel registry.
Connect the fused T8 candidate directly to the packed public proof envelope without replaying the standalone BL wrapper.
Run the full native/platform matrix from the integrated source identity.
